column2: Strategy north star — full self-serve design platform vision
column7: This is the Option 2 future stated explicitly. Every AI card is a step toward it. Helps prioritize: cards that complete the journey > cards that decorate it.

column2: SEO off-site — backlink + content + social playbook (recurring/ongoing)
column7: On-site SEO (S-007 series) is necessary but not sufficient. Off-site signals (links + brand mentions + social engagement) drive most of the ranking weight for competitive queries like 'AI interior design tool'.

column2: Apply-and-re-run — designer corrections (and keep/use notes) that reach the prompt
column7: THIS IS WHAT MAKES DESIGNER CHECK (AI-038) SELLABLE. Without it a designer writes 'move the bed to the long wall' and the visitor has no way to act on it — AI Vision cannot take 'move the bed', it can only regenerate a different room. The advice becomes homework, and the check has sold a problem instead of a solution. That is why AI-038 ships FREE and advice-only until this lands. Separately, the KEEP half is a differentiator on its own: every rival tool deletes the user's things, and nobody solves it.

column3: Approved (route decided 2026-09-06: PWA with push, not a store wrap)
column7: Keeps existing users coming back and alerts the owner the second someone pays or books. Will not bring new users.

column2: AI Vision — Spatial recognition of the room (dimensions, layout, fixed features)
column7: AI Vision currently generates concepts based on style + inspirations only — it doesn't know YOUR room's actual constraints. Owner explicit feedback 2026-05-19: 'we need to figure out how to add spatial recognition of the space.' Big quality lift. Differentiator vs. generic AI redesign tools.

column2: SEO Phase 3 — Reviews / AggregateRating schema from testimonials
column7: Star ratings in SERPs visibly increase clicks. Testimonials already exist on site — wasted SEO signal until structured.

column2: Paid consultation — decide WHERE on the website to surface it (Services / Pricing / Header / etc.)
column7: Right now there's only one booking action on the whole site = free Calendly. A paid consultation captures a different audience (global DIY-minded vs local project-ready) and a different revenue stream (productized advice vs full-project funnel). Aligns with new 'Online interior design studio' positioning (B-005) — paid video consultations are the perfect online-studio scalable product. Without deciding placement, the paid offering can't surface without breaking the current 'one clear action' funnel discipline.

column2: Paid consultation — define WHAT'S INCLUDED (duration, format, takeaway deliverable, price, booking flow)
column7: Defining the product is the precondition for both pricing it and selling it. Owner explicitly committed to delivering a takeaway and validating demand before scaling. Wrong takeaway = no paid bookings; right takeaway = a real revenue stream that scales globally without per-project labor. This is the FOUNDATIONAL decision; placement (S-026), pricing-page surface, and Wave 3 e-commerce checkout all depend on it.

column2: Region routing — full launch across remaining markets (EU + Armenia)
column7: Completes the four-region coverage envisioned in the shopping-list-strategy memory. By the time this ships, the SL-001 + SL-008 pattern will be proven, so EU + AM are pattern-application not pattern-invention.

column2: Plumb My Room — wet-services plan (sanitary, drainage, supply)
column7: No kitchen or bathroom route can complete without it, and those are the two highest-spend rooms in any home. Drainage falls and stack positions decide a wet-room layout before anything aesthetic does — a render that ignores them is a convincing picture of a room nobody can build.

column2: Schedule My Finishes — room-by-room finishes schedule with quantities
column7: The card that makes Shop My Room useful to a renovator rather than a decorator. Without it Shop can only ever buy furniture — which is exactly where a renovating visitor hits the wall today. Highest-frequency unbuilt card on the AI-032 v2 route map: 4 of 11 routes run through it.

column2: Pipeline-driven engagement app — push notifications + full site parity
column7: The website is transactional — visit, do a tool, leave. A design project is a month-long journey with many stages. Push notifications are the only reliable channel to bring a user back at the RIGHT moment for the NEXT stage of THEIR pipeline. Also protects retention against generic AI chatbots that lack a personal journey model.

column2: Designer Check — written designer review at any step of a workflow
column7: The missing rung on the price ladder. Today it is $19/mo, $49/mo, or a full project costing thousands, with nothing in between — and that gap is where most people stall. It gives the Studio tier a reason to exist that is NOT 'more generations', which is the weakest possible upgrade argument and the one the tiers currently rest on. It is also the studio's real differentiator made visible at the exact moment someone is deciding whether to trust a step, and the warmest sales moment in the business — the designer has just looked at the actual room and the actual layout. Finally it converts the two honest-exit scenarios (mid-renovation, commercial fit-out) from a booking form into a sellable product.

column2: Virtual-staging engine (fal FLUX) — re-test vs Gemini before activating

column2: Custom route — describe your situation, get your own pipeline
column7: Two jobs. (1) It catches everyone the eleven named scenarios do not describe, instead of dead-ending them. (2) It is the research instrument: every description is a scenario nobody has written yet — cluster them, author scenarios 12/13/14 from real customer language, then move those into the deterministic table. The share of traffic taking Custom should FALL over time; that number is the feature's own success metric. It is also a free, continuous source of real customer vocabulary for ad copy and GEO phrase selection.
